scope: Source-reviewed feature areas; implementation presence is not production acceptance certification.

modules.label: Identity & access
modules.purpose: Accounts, roles, teams, invitations, access requests, login/reset/Google sign-in.
modules.permissions: iam.* plus controller role hierarchy; self-service uses requireAuth
modules.workflow: Invite pending → accepted/cancelled/expired; access request pending → approved/rejected/invited; user active flag.
modules.relationships: User.role is a Role key; clientId links Customer; User.team is a key/string; HRStaff.teamId is an ObjectId.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Avatars reference public Media. SMTP sends invite/reset emails; IAM actions log Audit.
modules.status: Active; permission editor/catalog drift and hard-coded admin hierarchy need review.

modules.label: Clients / customers
modules.purpose: Operational companies and their linked portal logins, distinct from prospect CRM accounts.
modules.permissions: customers.read/write/delete plus tenant checks
modules.workflow: Active/inactive companies; create linked client login; company department digital_agency/procurement/both.
modules.relationships: Hub for projects, enrollments, billing, procurement, files, messages, brand assets and metrics; CRM conversion can create/link a Customer.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Company logo uses Media; login creation returns credentials to the operator; no automatic welcome-email workflow is established here.
modules.status: Active CRUD and login surfaces; two login creation endpoints overlap and require review.

modules.label: CRM / sales
modules.purpose: Prospect leads, accounts, contacts, deals and polymorphic activities.
modules.permissions: crm.read/write/delete; external users lose crm.* in roleRegistry
modules.workflow: Lead new/contacted/qualified/unqualified/converted; deal open/won/lost/archived with pipeline/stage constants; activity pending/done/cancelled.
modules.relationships: Plan submission creates lead/contact. Lead conversion links account/deal/contact; deal conversion creates/links an operational Customer. No automatic paid contract is implied.
modules.filesAndNotifications: No domain upload pipeline; activities record calls/emails/tasks but do not themselves send email.
modules.status: Active; multi-record conversion is not transactional and overlapping conversion link fields need consolidation.

modules.label: Service catalog / templates
modules.purpose: Reusable commercial scope groups, deliverables, prices, execution modes, SLA and file definitions.
modules.permissions: services.read/write/delete; internal permission prefixes
modules.workflow: draft/active/archived; recurring/phased_project/one_time execution; monthly/quarterly/yearly/one_time billing.
modules.relationships: Enrollments copy/override template scope into finalScope; the catalog is not the public DigitalService CMS collection.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Template attachments use privateStorage via shared upload middleware; cover imagery uses Media. No automated notifications.
modules.status: Active builder; sample presets and overlapping quick-create/builder controls need business review.

modules.label: Client service enrollments
modules.purpose: A client-specific service subscription/engagement with pricing, scope overrides and responsibility assignments.
modules.permissions: enrollments.read/write/delete; internal-only permission prefix
modules.workflow: String status (default active), dates, execution/pricing snapshots; schema does not enforce a single universal lifecycle enum.
modules.relationships: References Customer/template and optional Project. Jobs can be explicitly generated from finalScope; creation alone is not automatic project/invoice creation.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Scope may include file/approval metadata; no dedicated upload endpoint or external notification on enrollment creation.
modules.status: Active; scope normalization is duplicated and linking/generation is a partly manual lifecycle.

modules.label: Projects
modules.purpose: Delivery containers for customer work, enrollment-linked work and internal projects.
modules.permissions: projects.read/write/delete; list and detail reads check the company, but create, update (including customerId reassignment) and delete do not — see RBAC map and remediation P0-2
modules.workflow: draft/planned/active/on_hold/in_review/completed/archived/cancelled are UI/code conventions, stored as strings. Archiving is PATCH status=archived; DELETE (controller archiveProject) permanently deletes the project and leaves linked jobs, invoices, files and tickets orphaned (remediation P2-4).
modules.relationships: Jobs, files, invoices and enrollment links share projectId; pre_contract/contracted/custom/internal modes.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Project files use File/privateStorage; no automated project update email found.
modules.status: Active; create/update/delete lack company checks for externally granted projects.write/delete (P0-2) and DELETE is a hard delete (P2-4).

modules.label: Delivery jobs / approvals
modules.purpose: Tasks and content deliverables, assignments, media, approval history, publication and post metrics.
modules.permissions: jobs.read/write/delete; external permission prefix denied
modules.workflow: brief → script/pre_production → designing/shooting/editing → internal_review/client_review → approved/scheduled → published/delivered; on_hold/archived; separate publishStatus.
modules.relationships: Generated from enrollment scopes; also drives Productions, content calendar, customer/project tabs and public website reels.
modules.filesAndNotifications: draft/final/poster Media references, approval subdocuments; approval entries are stored history, not guaranteed email messages.
modules.status: Active; board stages duplicated in several views and state transitions are not one central workflow engine.

modules.label: Service delivery overview
modules.purpose: Cross-project overview of scopes and delivery jobs.
modules.permissions: UI projects.read; underlying requests require their own permissions
modules.workflow: Aggregates job and project states; no separate delivery collection.
modules.relationships: A view over existing operational records, not another project or job system.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Uses linked job/file metadata; no separate notifications.
modules.status: Active aggregate; access can differ from underlying API requirements.

modules.label: Production workspace
modules.purpose: Creative/video workflow presented as a specialized view of delivery jobs.
modules.api: Current workspace: /api/jobs via productions/jobs.api.js; older /api/productions API still mounted
modules.permissions: UI productions.read; actual workspace requires jobs.read/write/delete
modules.workflow: Current Job stages; old Production uses draft/published/archived, a different concept.
modules.relationships: Public reels now come from Job. Legacy Production is still referenced by Job.productionId and media-library API exports.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Uses Media attachments and shared creative review history; no separate production email worker.
modules.status: Partial consolidation: UI uses Job while an older Production stack and unused panels remain.

modules.label: Media library
modules.purpose: Shared public website and creative-work assets with image/video processing and metadata.
modules.api: /api/media; unused legacy production functions share this API module
modules.permissions: media.read/write/delete; internal-only permission prefix
modules.workflow: draft/published/archived asset metadata; image/video/file types.
modules.relationships: Referenced by CMS, jobs, portfolios, logos, brand assets and older business fields.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Multer memory upload → Sharp variants for images → public S3 or development uploads directory. No external notification.
modules.status: Active; public media must not be treated as confidential File/CV storage.

modules.label: Client/project files
modules.purpose: Private attachments, access visibility, approvals and signed downloads.
modules.permissions: files.read/write/delete plus internal/client visibility and tenant ownership checks
modules.workflow: visibility internal/client; approved boolean; independent of Media publish status.
modules.relationships: Links operational records and retains legacy public URL metadata alongside current private keys.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Private S3 prefix/bucket or private-uploads in development; signed links; legacy public objects require explicit migration review.
modules.status: Active mixed-era storage model; do not delete legacy metadata before object reconciliation.

modules.label: Finance / invoices & payments
modules.purpose: Invoice items, totals, manual payments, paid/void/overdue actions and aggregates.
modules.permissions: billing.read/write; external users cannot hold billing.write/delete; tenant-scoped reads
modules.workflow: draft/sent/paid/overdue/void; payments recompute amountPaid/balance via model save hook.
modules.relationships: Connects to customer/project/enrollment; no Payment collection or accounting ledger integration. Expenses are a separate HR workflow.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Invoice uploads are URL descriptors; no payment gateway, invoice-send email service or automatic overdue scheduler found.
modules.status: Active manual finance workflow; billing.delete is catalog-only. Invoice numbers are last-number + 1 on a unique field, so simultaneous creation fails with an error rather than duplicating (P2-3).

modules.label: Procurement / vendor operations
modules.purpose: Categories, vendor onboarding, client requests, RFQs, supplier matching and quotations.
modules.permissions: procurement.read/write/approve/delete; internal gates on vendor/category/RFQ reads; quotation submit has vendor role alias
modules.workflow: Request new/assessing/quoted/approved/ordered/delivered/cancelled; RFQ draft/published/closed/awarded; quotation submitted/under_review/accepted/rejected; application pending/approved/rejected.
modules.relationships: Application approval creates vendor User/profile; request → RFQ; matching uses category ObjectIds; quotations link RFQ/vendor. No separate purchase-order or inventory model.
modules.filesAndNotifications: RFQ/quotation attachments are URL descriptors; optional SMTP on RFQ publish; approval returns temporary credentials, without an enforced first-login-change flow.
modules.status: Partial vendor journey: vendor-specific controller/UI branches exist but RFQ read routes and frontend denylist block vendor access.

modules.label: People / HR
modules.purpose: Staff profiles, skills, scorecards, learning goals, leave, expenses and KPI indicators/goals/check-ins.
modules.permissions: hr.staff.*, hr.expenses.*, hr.leaves.*, hr.scorecards.*, hr.kpi.*; owner-scoped self-service; no self-approval
modules.workflow: Expense submitted→approved→registered→paid or rejected; leave submitted→approved/rejected/cancelled; staff active/on_leave/probation/inactive/terminated; KPI active/completed/at_risk/missed/cancelled.
modules.relationships: Staff linkedUserId differs from actor/staffUserId on claims; KPI autoSource can derive from leave, expense, scorecard and learning data.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Receipts are URL/legacy Media fields, not a proven private receipt-upload flow. No automated HR emails found.
modules.status: Active workflows; KPI UI gate/catalog drift, arbitrary receipt URLs and linkage consistency need review.

modules.label: Content calendar / metrics
modules.purpose: Scheduled/published content calendar and manually recorded social performance.
modules.permissions: Route gate jobs.read; metric endpoints social.metrics.read/write
modules.workflow: Job schedule/publication states; metric period/platform dimensions.
modules.relationships: Calendar joins delivery jobs to customer social metrics; not a live social-network publishing connector.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Uses job media and optional externalPostUrl. No social platform OAuth/API publishing integration found.
modules.status: Active manual tracking; social permission keys are missing from static frontend catalog.

modules.label: Messaging / unread notifications
modules.purpose: Company-thread messages, read markers and inbox counts.
modules.permissions: messaging.read/write plus customer-scoped authorization
modules.workflow: Persisted messages and readBy user IDs; internal/client sender distinction.
modules.relationships: Topbar polls unread counts every 60 seconds; no standalone Notification model, websocket or queue.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Attachments are URL strings, not automatic secure file ownership checks on arbitrary links; no message email delivery found.
modules.status: Active polling implementation; most notification preferences are stored settings, not shipped notification automations.

modules.label: Client brand kit
modules.purpose: Per-client logos, colors, fonts, guidelines and templates.
modules.permissions: brand_kit.read/write and tenant checks
modules.workflow: Asset type logo/color/font/guideline/template/icon; no formal publish lifecycle.
modules.relationships: Client workspace brand data differs from public site branding stored in SiteSettings/code.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Media references and URL values; no independent mail/notification mechanism.
modules.status: Active; keys absent from static frontend permission catalog.

modules.label: Website CMS
modules.purpose: Homepage slides/settings, public Digital Services and shared Digital/Technology Solution records.
modules.permissions: website.read/write; public reads are separate routes, with publication-boundary issues documented
modules.workflow: Slides/records use isActive and order; Solution kind digital/technology with derived ownership and technology group.
modules.relationships: One Solution CMS feeds two public sections. CAS registry guarantees core discovery; CMS only enriches CAS and adds other products.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Images use Media/SiteSettings overrides; no publish-event notification system.
modules.status: Active; CMS cannot edit all page copy; public includeInactive/detail reads need review.

modules.label: Portfolio CMS
modules.purpose: Case Studies (editable public case studies, /case-studies) and Portfolio (visual work items, /portfolio).
modules.permissions: Case studies: portfolio.read/write/delete; Portfolio work: work.read/write/delete; public GETs serve published records only
modules.workflow: draft/published/archived, publication date and approval/system fields.
modules.relationships: Portfolio model feeds /case-studies (detail by slug or ObjectId); WorkItem feeds /portfolio and /portfolio/:slug and may link one case study. Separate from work-delivery Project.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Media cover/gallery refs, static fallback assets; no portfolio publication notifications.
modules.status: Active; public case-study/work reads filter unpublished records; managers need the respective portfolio.read or work.read permission.

modules.label: Careers CMS / applications
modules.purpose: Job vacancy publishing and candidate application review.
modules.permissions: website.read/write; public vacancy/application/CV-upload entry points
modules.workflow: Career isActive; application new/reviewing/interview/rejected/hired.
modules.relationships: Public /careers form uses a separate CV upload then application creation; no automatic HRStaff/User conversion.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Private CV keys with signed authorized download; orphan uploads possible if a candidate never submits; no automatic candidate mail found.
modules.status: Active review workflow; publication, retention and upload abuse controls need review.

modules.label: Support / change requests
modules.purpose: Customer/internal/procurement support threads, assignments, approvals and resolution.
modules.permissions: tickets.read/write/delete plus actor/visibility/tenant checks; DELETE has no company check (P0-2)
modules.workflow: open/in_progress/waiting_client/waiting_vendor/in_review/escalated/resolved/closed; change request approval pending/approved/rejected.
modules.relationships: Connects customers/projects/users, with embedded comments and legacy clientId referring to User, not Customer.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Attachments are embedded URL metadata; internal/client comment visibility; no automatic ticket email service found.
modules.status: Active; legacy authorRole enum client/admin is narrower than current role registry.

modules.label: Role dashboards
modules.purpose: Role-specific internal, client and vendor summaries over operational modules.
modules.api: Module list/stats endpoints: jobs, tickets, customers, projects, CRM, procurement, billing, HR, enrollments
modules.permissions: Authenticated shell; individual APIs enforce domain permissions; some fetches use Promise.allSettled
modules.workflow: No persisted dashboard lifecycle; vendor RFQ load is currently denied by API internal gate.
modules.relationships: Role-name branches select dashboards; custom roles are not automatically equivalent to every built-in dashboard.
modules.filesAndNotifications: No uploads; unread notifications come from messaging.
modules.status: Active aggregate with role assumptions; a denied/failed metric can look empty or zero.

modules.label: Reports
modules.purpose: Browser-built operational summaries from several module statistics endpoints.
modules.permissions: UI reports.read; APIs enforce their own read/approve permissions; reports.export has no implementation found
modules.workflow: Snapshots computed from operational data; no scheduled report lifecycle.
modules.relationships: Granting reports.read alone does not grant access to source statistics.
modules.filesAndNotifications: No dedicated report export storage or mail scheduler found.
modules.status: Partial reporting surface; unused API wrapper duplicates inline requests and export permission is unused.

modules.label: Activity / audit trail
modules.purpose: Filter and inspect IAM/system audit events.
modules.permissions: activity.read plus authentication
modules.workflow: Append-only audit records; no universal business event bus.
modules.relationships: Most logAudit calls are IAM operations; CRMActivity and Job approval history are separate domain histories.
modules.filesAndNotifications: No uploads or external notifications; audit logging is not a substitute for DB/file backup.
modules.status: Active IAM-focused audit surface; activity/api.js wrapper is unused.

modules.label: My profile
modules.purpose: Current account identity and profile preferences.
modules.permissions: requireAuth self-service field whitelist
modules.workflow: Profile edits and avatar URL/Media metadata; no separate Profile collection.
modules.relationships: Shares the same User record as IAM, login and staff links.
modules.filesAndNotifications: Avatar Media references/URLs; no dedicated profile notification.
modules.status: Active page; unused profile API/hook wrappers duplicate direct requests.

modules.label: My settings
modules.purpose: Own profile/password/notification preference settings.
modules.permissions: Authenticated self-service; password change checks current password
modules.workflow: Password change invalidates older tokens through passwordChangedAt; notification switches are persisted preferences.
modules.relationships: Not environment configuration and not SiteSettings; there is no general application-settings collection here.
modules.filesAndNotifications: No uploads; preference toggles do not prove downstream project/ticket/billing email delivery.
modules.status: Active self-service; unused settings API wrapper duplicates direct calls.
